examples.title: Configure the Blur effect
examples.code:
# Create a Gaussian Blur that affects only alpha.
blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur["filter"].setValue("gaussian")
blur["channels"].setValue("alpha")
blur["size"].setValue([20, 20])

# Change it to a horizontal blur.
blur["size"].setValue([30, 0])

# Process RGB instead of alpha.
blur["channels"].setValue("rgb")

examples.title: Change every Blur node in the script
examples.code:
# Give every Blur node the same Gaussian RGB blur.
for blur in nuke.allNodes("Blur"):
    blur["filter"].setValue("gaussian")
    blur["channels"].setValue("rgb")
    blur["size"].setValue([10, 10])
